title: My Friend's Mum Said: Keep Your Feet Under The Blanket
cta: Tag a friend who sleeps with one foot out
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. Would you have broken the rule? Tell us in the comments.
lines: My friend's mum had one rule for sleepovers.
Keep your feet under the blanket. All night.
My friend nodded like it was normal.
At 3 a.m., I got hot. One foot slipped out.
Something under the bed started counting.
In the morning, I pulled off my sock. I counted eleven.
